subject: OS
lessonTitleEn: Input/Output: Hardware, Software, Disk, Terminals, Clocks

asked.question: Blocking এবং Buffering OS এর পার্থক্য লিখুন।

Consider a disk pack with the following specifications- 16 surfaces, 128 tracks per surface, 256 sectors per track and 512 bytes per sector. Answer the following questions- (i) What is the capacity of disk pack? (ii) What is the capacity of disk pack? (iii) If the format overhead is 32 bytes per sector, what is the formatted disk space?

Consider a disk pack with the following specifications- 16 surfaces, 128 tracks per surface, 256 sectors per track and 512 bytes per sector. Answer the following questions- a) What is the capacity of disk pack? b) What is the number of bits required to address the sector? c) If the format overhead is 32 bytes per sector, what is the formatted disk space? d) If the format overhead is 64 bytes per sector, how much amount of memory is lost due to formatting?
Garbage collection is required in SSD, because: (ক) SSD cells must be erased before being written (খ) SSDs cannot store large files (গ) SSDs do not support random access (ঘ) it reduces read latency
What is access time and transfer time?

In a disk, disk requests come in to the disk driver for cylinders 10, 22, 20, 2, 40, 6 and 38. A seek takes 6 msec per cylinder moved. How much seek time in msec is needed for the Elevator Algorithm, if the initial arm position is at cylinder 20 moving upward. (a) 876 (b) 58 (c) 348 (d) 360
Showing disk size, disk space in human readable format.

mustKnow.en: I/O devices are block devices (addressable fixed-size blocks: disk, SSD) or character devices (stream, no addressing: keyboard, mouse, printer); clocks fit neither.
mustKnow.bn: I/O device হয় block device (address-যোগ্য নির্দিষ্ট আকারের block: disk, SSD) বা character device (ধারা, address নেই: keyboard, mouse, printer); clock কোনোটিই নয়।

mustKnow.en: A device controller (adapter) sits between device and bus and exposes status, control, data-in and data-out registers; the driver programs these registers.
mustKnow.bn: Device controller (adapter) device ও bus-এর মাঝে থাকে এবং status, control, data-in ও data-out register দেয়; driver এগুলো program করে।

mustKnow.en: Port-mapped (isolated) I/O uses a separate port space and IN/OUT instructions; memory-mapped I/O puts device registers in the memory address space (ordinary load/store).
mustKnow.bn: Port-mapped (isolated) I/O আলাদা port space ও IN/OUT instruction ব্যবহার করে; memory-mapped I/O device register-কে memory address space-এ রাখে (সাধারণ load/store)।

mustKnow.en: Three ways to do I/O: programmed I/O (polling, busy waiting), interrupt-driven I/O (one interrupt per character/word), DMA (one interrupt per block).
mustKnow.bn: I/O-র তিন পদ্ধতি: programmed I/O (polling, busy waiting), interrupt-driven I/O (প্রতি character/word-এ একটি interrupt), DMA (প্রতি block-এ একটি interrupt)।

mustKnow.en: DMA: a DMA controller moves a block between device and memory without the CPU; modes are cycle stealing (one word at a time) and burst/block mode.
mustKnow.bn: DMA: DMA controller CPU ছাড়াই device ও memory-র মধ্যে block সরায়; mode দুটি — cycle stealing (একবারে একটি word) ও burst/block mode।

mustKnow.en: Interrupt vector = table of interrupt-service-routine addresses indexed by interrupt number.
mustKnow.bn: Interrupt vector = interrupt number অনুযায়ী সাজানো interrupt-service-routine-এর address-এর table।

mustKnow.en: I/O software layers, bottom up: interrupt handlers → device drivers → device-independent OS software → user-level I/O (libraries, spoolers).
mustKnow.bn: I/O software-এর স্তর, নিচ থেকে: interrupt handler → device driver → device-independent OS software → user-level I/O (library, spooler)।

mustKnow.en: Device-independent layer: uniform driver interface, naming, protection, buffering, error reporting, allocating dedicated devices, device-independent block size.
mustKnow.bn: Device-independent স্তর: অভিন্ন driver interface, naming, protection, buffering, error reporting, dedicated device বরাদ্দ, device-independent block size।

mustKnow.en: Buffering handles speed mismatch, transfer-size mismatch and copy semantics; single, double and circular buffers. Spooling = buffering whole jobs on disk for a dedicated device (printer).
mustKnow.bn: Buffering গতির অমিল, transfer আকারের অমিল ও copy semantics সামলায়; single, double ও circular buffer। Spooling = dedicated device-এর (printer) জন্য পুরো job disk-এ buffer করা।

mustKnow.en: Blocking = packing logical records into physical blocks (blocking factor = block size / record size); blocking I/O = the process waits until I/O completes; non-blocking returns at once; asynchronous signals completion later.
mustKnow.bn: Blocking = logical record-কে physical block-এ সাজানো (blocking factor = block size / record size); blocking I/O = I/O শেষ না হওয়া পর্যন্ত process অপেক্ষা করে; non-blocking সঙ্গে সঙ্গে ফেরে; asynchronous পরে সমাপ্তি জানায়।

mustKnow.en: Disk geometry: platter → surface → track → sector; cylinder = the same track on all surfaces. Capacity = surfaces × tracks/surface × sectors/track × bytes/sector.
mustKnow.bn: Disk geometry: platter → surface → track → sector; cylinder = সব surface-এর একই track। Capacity = surface × track/surface × sector/track × byte/sector।

mustKnow.en: Access time = seek time + rotational latency + transfer time (+ controller overhead). Average latency = ½ revolution = 30,000 / rpm ms (7200 rpm → 4.17 ms; 6000 → 5 ms; 15,000 → 2 ms).
mustKnow.bn: Access time = seek time + rotational latency + transfer time (+ controller overhead)। গড় latency = ½ আবর্তন = 30,000 / rpm ms (7200 rpm → 4.17 ms; 6000 → 5 ms; 15,000 → 2 ms)।

mustKnow.en: Disk scheduling: FCFS (fair, slow), SSTF (least movement, can starve), SCAN = elevator (to the disk end), LOOK (turns at last request), C-SCAN/C-LOOK (one direction, uniform wait).
mustKnow.bn: Disk scheduling: FCFS (ন্যায্য, ধীর), SSTF (কম চলাচল, starvation হতে পারে), SCAN = elevator (disk-এর প্রান্ত পর্যন্ত), LOOK (শেষ request-এ ঘোরে), C-SCAN/C-LOOK (এক দিকে, সমান অপেক্ষা)।

mustKnow.en: Low-level formatting creates sectors (header + data + ECC); then partitioning and logical formatting (file system). MBR = sector 0: 446 B boot code + 64 B partition table + 0x55AA.
mustKnow.bn: Low-level formatting sector তৈরি করে (header + data + ECC); তারপর partitioning ও logical formatting (file system)। MBR = sector 0: 446 B boot code + 64 B partition table + 0x55AA।

mustKnow.en: Bad blocks are hidden by sector sparing (forwarding to a spare) or sector slipping.
mustKnow.bn: Bad block লুকানো হয় sector sparing (spare-এ forwarding) বা sector slipping দিয়ে।

mustKnow.en: SSD: no seek or rotation; pages written, blocks erased (erase-before-write) → garbage collection, TRIM, wear leveling; OS uses FCFS/NOOP or deadline scheduling.
mustKnow.bn: SSD: seek বা ঘূর্ণন নেই; page-এ লেখা, block-এ erase (erase-before-write) → garbage collection, TRIM, wear leveling; OS FCFS/NOOP বা deadline scheduling ব্যবহার করে।

mustKnow.en: Programmable clock = crystal + counter + holding register; one-shot or square-wave mode. Tick rate = crystal frequency / counter value (1 GHz / 10⁶ = 1000 Hz).
mustKnow.bn: Programmable clock = crystal + counter + holding register; one-shot বা square-wave mode। Tick rate = crystal frequency / counter value (1 GHz / 10⁶ = 1000 Hz)।

mustKnow.en: Clock driver: time of day, quantum enforcement (preemption), CPU accounting, alarms, watchdog timers, profiling.
mustKnow.bn: Clock driver: দিনের সময়, quantum প্রয়োগ (preemption), CPU accounting, alarm, watchdog timer, profiling।

mustKnow.en: Terminals: keyboard sends scan codes; the line discipline echoes and edits. Canonical (cooked) mode delivers whole lines; raw mode delivers each key (vi, top).
mustKnow.bn: Terminal: keyboard scan code পাঠায়; line discipline echo ও edit করে। Canonical (cooked) mode পুরো লাইন দেয়; raw mode প্রতিটি key দেয় (vi, top)।

mustKnow.en: FAT32: linked clusters in a table, 4 GB file limit, no permissions or journaling. NTFS: Master File Table, journaling, ACLs, compression, encryption.
mustKnow.bn: FAT32: table-এ linked cluster, 4 GB file সীমা, permission বা journaling নেই। NTFS: Master File Table, journaling, ACL, compression, encryption।

title.en: Disk pack capacity and sector address bits
title.bn: Disk pack capacity ও sector address bit

formulas.formula: Capacity = S × T × s × B ;  sectors = S × T × s ;  address bits = log₂(sectors) ;  formatted = sectors × (B − overhead)

question.en: 16 surfaces, 128 tracks/surface, 256 sectors/track, 512 B/sector; format overhead 32 B/sector. (Combined Bank SO(IT) 2022)
question.bn: 16 surface, 128 track/surface, 256 sector/track, 512 B/sector; format overhead 32 B/sector। (Combined Bank SO(IT) 2022)

working.en: Sectors = 2⁴ × 2⁷ × 2⁸ = 2¹⁹ = 524,288 → 19 bits. Capacity = 2¹⁹ × 2⁹ = 2²⁸ B = 256 MB. Formatted = 524,288 × 480 = 251,658,240 B = 240 MB. With 64 B overhead, 524,288 × 64 = 32 MB is lost.
working.bn: Sector = 2⁴ × 2⁷ × 2⁸ = 2¹⁹ = 524,288 → 19 bit। Capacity = 2¹⁹ × 2⁹ = 2²⁸ B = 256 MB। Formatted = 524,288 × 480 = 251,658,240 B = 240 MB। 64 B overhead-এ 524,288 × 64 = 32 MB নষ্ট।

example.answer: 256 MB; 19 bits; 240 MB formatted; 32 MB lost at 64 B overhead

formulas.formula: T = seek + ½ × (60 / rpm) + data / rate (+ controller overhead)

question.en: 7200 rpm, 4 ms average seek, 100 MB/s, 4 KB block, 0.2 ms overhead. Find T.
question.bn: 7200 rpm, গড় seek 4 ms, 100 MB/s, 4 KB block, 0.2 ms overhead। T বের করুন।

formulas.formula: Moving up first: movement = (max request − head) + (max request − min request)  [LOOK];  time = movement × time per cylinder

question.en: Requests 10, 22, 20, 2, 40, 6, 38; head at 20 moving up; 6 ms per cylinder. (BUET M.Sc. April 2021)
question.bn: Request 10, 22, 20, 2, 40, 6, 38; head 20-এ, উপরের দিকে; প্রতি cylinder 6 ms। (BUET M.Sc. April 2021)

working.en: 20 → 22 → 38 → 40 → 10 → 6 → 2: (40 − 20) + (40 − 2) = 58 cylinders × 6 ms = 348 ms. For comparison: SSTF 60 cyl = 360 ms, FCFS 146 cyl = 876 ms.

formulas.formula: Total head movement = Σ |next − current| along the service order

example.answer: FCFS 642, SSTF 208, SCAN 332, LOOK 314, C-SCAN 391, C-LOOK 341

formulas.formula: Interrupts per second = crystal frequency / counter value ;  tick interval = counter value / crystal frequency

question.en: A 1 GHz crystal; the counter is loaded with 1,000,000 in square-wave mode.
question.bn: 1 GHz crystal; square-wave mode-এ counter-এ 1,000,000 load করা।

working.en: 1,000,000 × 1 ns = 1 ms per tick → 10⁹ / 10⁶ = 1000 interrupts per second.
working.bn: 1,000,000 × 1 ns = প্রতি tick 1 ms → 10⁹ / 10⁶ = প্রতি সেকেন্ডে 1000 interrupt।

traps.en: BUET elevator MCQ: 58 is the cylinder count, not the time — multiply by 6 ms/cylinder to get 348 ms. 360 ms is SSTF and 876 ms is FCFS.
traps.bn: BUET elevator MCQ: 58 হলো cylinder সংখ্যা, সময় নয় — 6 ms/cylinder দিয়ে গুণ করে 348 ms। 360 ms হলো SSTF, 876 ms FCFS।

traps.en: Average rotational latency is HALF a revolution (7200 rpm → 4.17 ms), not a full revolution (8.33 ms).
traps.bn: গড় rotational latency অর্ধেক আবর্তন (7200 rpm → 4.17 ms), পূর্ণ আবর্তন (8.33 ms) নয়।

traps.en: SCAN goes to the disk edge (e.g. 199) before reversing; LOOK turns at the last request. Mixing them up changes the total (332 vs 314 in the kit example).
traps.bn: SCAN ফেরার আগে disk-এর প্রান্ত (যেমন 199) পর্যন্ত যায়; LOOK শেষ request-এ ঘোরে। গুলিয়ে ফেললে মোট বদলে যায় (kit-এর উদাহরণে 332 বনাম 314)।

traps.en: C-SCAN/C-LOOK totals depend on whether the return sweep is counted (391 vs 192). State your convention in a written answer.
traps.bn: C-SCAN/C-LOOK-এর মোট নির্ভর করে ফেরার পথ গোনা হয় কি না (391 বনাম 192)। Written উত্তরে নিজের রীতি উল্লেখ করুন।

traps.en: Disk-pack sector address bits count sectors (2¹⁹ → 19 bits), not bytes (2²⁸ → 28 bits). Capacities in these papers use binary MB (2²⁰).
traps.bn: Disk-pack-এর sector address bit sector গোনে (2¹⁹ → 19 bit), byte নয় (2²⁸ → 28 bit)। এসব প্রশ্নে capacity binary MB (2²⁰)-এ।

traps.en: SSTF is not optimal and can starve far requests; it is 'shortest seek first', not 'shortest job first'.
traps.bn: SSTF optimal নয় এবং দূরের request starvation-এ পড়তে পারে; এটি 'shortest seek first', 'shortest job first' নয়।

traps.en: DMA still interrupts the CPU — once per block, not per byte. And cycle stealing slows the CPU slightly; DMA is not 'zero CPU cost'.
traps.bn: DMA-ও CPU-কে interrupt করে — প্রতি block-এ একবার, প্রতি byte-এ নয়। আর cycle stealing CPU-কে সামান্য ধীর করে; DMA 'শূন্য CPU খরচ' নয়।

traps.en: A buffer can hold the only copy of data in transit; a cache always holds a copy of data that also exists elsewhere.
traps.bn: Buffer-এ চলমান data-র একমাত্র কপি থাকতে পারে; cache-এ সবসময় এমন data-র কপি থাকে যা অন্যত্রও আছে।

traps.en: SSD garbage collection is needed because flash must be erased (by block) before rewriting — not because SSDs lack random access or to cut read latency.
traps.bn: SSD-তে garbage collection লাগে কারণ আবার লেখার আগে flash (block ধরে) erase করতে হয় — SSD-তে random access নেই বা read latency কমাতে, এমন নয়।

traps.en: 'Blocking vs buffering' (NTRCA) is about record blocking vs memory buffers, not only about blocking I/O; cover both meanings.
traps.bn: 'Blocking বনাম buffering' (NTRCA) মানে record blocking বনাম memory buffer, শুধু blocking I/O নয়; দুটি অর্থই উল্লেখ করুন।

q.en: What does DMA stand for and why use it?
q.bn: DMA-এর পূর্ণরূপ কী এবং কেন ব্যবহার করা হয়?

a.en: Direct Memory Access: moves a whole block between device and memory without the CPU, interrupting once at the end.
a.bn: Direct Memory Access: CPU ছাড়াই device ও memory-র মধ্যে পুরো block সরায়, শেষে একবার interrupt দেয়।

a.en: The CPU repeatedly checks a device's status register until it is ready (busy waiting).
a.bn: Device প্রস্তুত না হওয়া পর্যন্ত CPU বারবার এর status register পরীক্ষা করে (busy waiting)।

q.en: Name the three parts of disk access time.
q.bn: Disk access time-এর তিনটি অংশের নাম বলুন।

a.en: Seek time, rotational latency and transfer time.
a.bn: Seek time, rotational latency ও transfer time।

q.en: Why is SCAN called the elevator algorithm?
q.bn: SCAN-কে কেন elevator algorithm বলা হয়?

a.en: Like a lift, the arm keeps moving in one direction serving requests, then reverses.
a.bn: Lift-এর মতো arm এক দিকে চলতে চলতে request সেবা দেয়, তারপর দিক বদলায়।

q.en: What is the drawback of SSTF?

a.en: Starvation of requests far from the head.
The set of tracks at the same arm position on all surfaces.
a.bn: সব surface-এ একই arm অবস্থানের track-গুলোর সমষ্টি।

q.en: Why does an SSD need TRIM?

a.en: To tell the drive which blocks are free so garbage collection doesn't copy dead data.
a.bn: কোন block মুক্ত তা drive-কে জানাতে, যাতে garbage collection মৃত data কপি না করে।

q.en: What does the clock driver do on every tick?
q.bn: প্রতি tick-এ clock driver কী করে?

a.en: Updates the time, charges the running process and decrements its quantum, and checks pending alarms.
a.bn: সময় হালনাগাদ করে, চলমান process-এর হিসাব রাখে ও quantum কমায়, এবং অপেক্ষমাণ alarm পরীক্ষা করে।

a.en: Cooked (canonical) gives whole edited lines; raw gives each keystroke immediately.
a.bn: Cooked (canonical) সম্পাদিত পুরো লাইন দেয়; raw প্রতিটি keystroke সঙ্গে সঙ্গে দেয়।

q.bn: কোন Linux command human-readable রূপে disk space দেখায়?

a.bn: df -h (আর একটি directory-র ব্যবহারের জন্য du -sh)।

answer.en:
Definitions:
Blocking: grouping several logical records into one physical block (the unit of disk I/O) so that one I/O operation transfers many records. Blocking factor = block size / record size (e.g. 4096 / 128 = 32 records per block). Types: fixed blocking, variable-length spanned and unspanned blocking.
Buffering: keeping data temporarily in a memory area (buffer) while it moves between a device and a process, or between two devices, to cope with differences in speed and transfer size. Types: single, double and circular buffering.

Diagram: blocking — [R1 R2 R3 … R32] = one disk block; buffering — device → [buffer A | buffer B] → process (one fills while the other empties).

Difference table:
Aspect | Blocking | Buffering
What it does | packs records into blocks | holds data temporarily in memory during transfer
Aim | fewer I/O operations, less inter-record gap / overhead | overlap I/O with computation, absorb speed mismatch
Where | layout of data on the storage device | main-memory area managed by the OS
Key parameter | blocking factor | number and size of buffers
Side effect | internal waste in the last block | memory used for buffers, copy overhead
Example | 32 records of 128 B in a 4 KB block | double buffering while reading a file or playing video

Related meaning: blocking I/O means a process is suspended until its I/O completes; buffering lets the OS complete a write into a buffer so the process can continue sooner.

Conclusion: the two work together: records are blocked on disk, and whole blocks are read into buffers, from which the process takes one record at a time.
answer.bn:
সংজ্ঞা:
Blocking: কয়েকটি logical record একত্র করে একটি physical block-এ (disk I/O-র একক) রাখা, যাতে একটি I/O operation-এ অনেক record আসে। Blocking factor = block size / record size (যেমন 4096 / 128 = প্রতি block-এ 32টি record)। প্রকার: fixed blocking, variable-length spanned ও unspanned blocking।
Buffering: data একটি device ও process-এর মধ্যে, বা দুটি device-এর মধ্যে যাওয়ার সময় সাময়িকভাবে memory-র একটি অংশে (buffer) রাখা, যাতে গতি ও transfer আকারের পার্থক্য সামলানো যায়। প্রকার: single, double ও circular buffering।

চিত্র: blocking — [R1 R2 R3 … R32] = একটি disk block; buffering — device → [buffer A | buffer B] → process (একটি ভরছে, অন্যটি খালি হচ্ছে)।

পার্থক্যের টেবিল:
বিষয় | Blocking | Buffering
কী করে | record-কে block-এ সাজায় | transfer-এর সময় data সাময়িকভাবে memory-তে রাখে
লক্ষ্য | কম I/O operation, কম inter-record gap / overhead | I/O ও computation একসাথে চালানো, গতির অমিল সামলানো
কোথায় | storage device-এ data-র বিন্যাস | OS-পরিচালিত main memory-র অংশ
মূল parameter | blocking factor | buffer-এর সংখ্যা ও আকার
পার্শ্বপ্রতিক্রিয়া | শেষ block-এ অভ্যন্তরীণ অপচয় | buffer-এ memory খরচ, copy overhead
উদাহরণ | 4 KB block-এ 128 B-এর 32টি record | file পড়া বা video চালানোর সময় double buffering

সম্পর্কিত অর্থ: blocking I/O মানে I/O শেষ না হওয়া পর্যন্ত process স্থগিত থাকে; buffering-এ OS write-কে buffer-এ শেষ করে দিতে পারে, ফলে process আগে এগোতে পারে।

উপসংহার: দুটি একসাথে কাজ করে: disk-এ record block আকারে থাকে, পুরো block buffer-এ পড়া হয়, আর process সেখান থেকে একটি করে record নেয়।

answer.en:
Given: surfaces = 16 = 2⁴, tracks/surface = 128 = 2⁷, sectors/track = 256 = 2⁸, bytes/sector = 512 = 2⁹.

(a) Capacity = 16 × 128 × 256 × 512 = 2⁴⁺⁷⁺⁸⁺⁹ = 2²⁸ bytes = 268,435,456 bytes = 256 MB.

(b) Total sectors = 16 × 128 × 256 = 2¹⁹ = 524,288, so 19 bits address a sector (4 bits surface + 7 bits track + 8 bits sector).

(c) Usable bytes per sector = 512 − 32 = 480. Formatted space = 524,288 × 480 = 251,658,240 bytes = 240 MB.

(d) Lost = 524,288 × 64 = 33,554,432 bytes = 32 MB (formatted space would be 224 MB).

Answer: (a) 256 MB; (b) 19 bits; (c) 240 MB; (d) 32 MB.
answer.bn:
দেওয়া আছে: surface = 16 = 2⁴, track/surface = 128 = 2⁷, sector/track = 256 = 2⁸, byte/sector = 512 = 2⁹।

(ক) Capacity = 16 × 128 × 256 × 512 = 2⁴⁺⁷⁺⁸⁺⁹ = 2²⁸ byte = 268,435,456 byte = 256 MB।

(খ) মোট sector = 16 × 128 × 256 = 2¹⁹ = 524,288, তাই একটি sector address করতে 19 bit (surface-এর 4 bit + track-এর 7 bit + sector-এর 8 bit)।

(গ) প্রতি sector-এ ব্যবহারযোগ্য byte = 512 − 32 = 480। Formatted space = 524,288 × 480 = 251,658,240 byte = 240 MB।

(ঘ) নষ্ট = 524,288 × 64 = 33,554,432 byte = 32 MB (formatted space হতো 224 MB)।

উত্তর: (ক) 256 MB; (খ) 19 bit; (গ) 240 MB; (ঘ) 32 MB।

answer.en:
Definitions:
Access time: the total time from issuing a disk request until the data transfer is complete (some books use it for seek + rotational latency only, i.e. the time to reach the data).
Transfer time: the time to actually read or write the data once the head is over the right sector = amount of data / transfer rate.

Components:
1. Seek time: moving the arm to the required cylinder (average 3–10 ms on hard disks; the largest part).
2. Rotational latency: waiting for the sector to rotate under the head; average = half a revolution = 0.5 × 60 / rpm.
3. Transfer time: bytes / transfer rate.
(4. Controller overhead and queuing delay, if given.)
Access time = seek + rotational latency + transfer (+ controller overhead).

Diagram: platter with tracks and sectors, the arm moving radially (seek) and the platter rotating (latency).

Example: 7200 rpm, average seek 4 ms, 100 MB/s, 4 KB block, 0.2 ms controller overhead.
Latency = 0.5 × 60,000 / 7200 = 4.17 ms; transfer = 4096 / (100 × 10⁶) s = 0.04 ms.
Access time = 4 + 4.17 + 0.04 + 0.2 ≈ 8.41 ms.

Observation: the mechanical parts (seek + latency) dominate; that is why OSes use disk scheduling, read larger blocks and cache data, and why SSDs (no moving parts) are much faster for random access.
answer.bn:
সংজ্ঞা:
Access time: disk request দেওয়া থেকে data transfer শেষ হওয়া পর্যন্ত মোট সময় (কিছু বইয়ে শুধু seek + rotational latency, অর্থাৎ data-য় পৌঁছানোর সময় বোঝায়)।
Transfer time: head সঠিক sector-এর উপর আসার পর data প্রকৃতপক্ষে পড়া বা লেখার সময় = data-র পরিমাণ / transfer rate।

উপাদান:
১. Seek time: arm-কে প্রয়োজনীয় cylinder-এ নেওয়া (hard disk-এ গড়ে 3–10 ms; সবচেয়ে বড় অংশ)।
২. Rotational latency: sector টি ঘুরে head-এর নিচে আসার অপেক্ষা; গড় = অর্ধেক আবর্তন = 0.5 × 60 / rpm।
৩. Transfer time: byte / transfer rate।
(৪. দেওয়া থাকলে controller overhead ও queuing delay।)
Access time = seek + rotational latency + transfer (+ controller overhead)।

চিত্র: track ও sector-সহ platter, arm ব্যাসার্ধ বরাবর সরছে (seek) এবং platter ঘুরছে (latency)।

উদাহরণ: 7200 rpm, গড় seek 4 ms, 100 MB/s, 4 KB block, 0.2 ms controller overhead।
Latency = 0.5 × 60,000 / 7200 = 4.17 ms; transfer = 4096 / (100 × 10⁶) s = 0.04 ms।
Access time = 4 + 4.17 + 0.04 + 0.2 ≈ 8.41 ms।

পর্যবেক্ষণ: যান্ত্রিক অংশ (seek + latency) প্রাধান্য পায়; এজন্যই OS disk scheduling করে, বড় block পড়ে ও cache করে, আর SSD (চলমান অংশ নেই) random access-এ অনেক দ্রুত।

answer.en: (ক) SSD cells must be erased before being written. NAND flash cannot overwrite a page in place: a page can be written only when empty, and erasing works on a whole block (many pages). Updated data is written to a new page and the old page is marked invalid; garbage collection copies the still-valid pages out of a block and erases it so the space can be reused.
answer.bn: (ক) SSD cells must be erased before being written। NAND flash-এ কোনো page-এর উপর সরাসরি আবার লেখা যায় না: page কেবল ফাঁকা থাকলেই লেখা যায়, আর erase হয় পুরো block ধরে (অনেক page)। নতুন data নতুন page-এ লেখা হয় এবং পুরনো page invalid চিহ্নিত হয়; garbage collection একটি block-এর বৈধ page-গুলো অন্যত্র কপি করে block টি erase করে, যাতে জায়গা আবার ব্যবহার করা যায়।

answer.en: (c) 348. Elevator: serve upward 20 → 22 → 38 → 40, then reverse 40 → 10 → 6 → 2 (the arm turns at the last request). Movement = (40 − 20) + (40 − 2) = 20 + 38 = 58 cylinders; time = 58 × 6 = 348 ms. 58 is the cylinder count (not ms), 360 ms is SSTF (60 cylinders) and 876 ms is FCFS (146 cylinders).
answer.bn: (c) 348। Elevator: উপরের দিকে 20 → 22 → 38 → 40, তারপর ফিরে 40 → 10 → 6 → 2 (শেষ request-এ arm ঘোরে)। মোট সরণ = (40 − 20) + (40 − 2) = 20 + 38 = 58 cylinder; সময় = 58 × 6 = 348 ms। 58 হলো cylinder সংখ্যা (ms নয়), 360 ms হলো SSTF (60 cylinder) এবং 876 ms হলো FCFS (146 cylinder)।

answer.en: df -h shows each mounted file system's size, used and available space in human-readable units (K, M, G); df -hT adds the file-system type. du -sh <dir> shows the space used by one directory; lsblk shows disks and partitions with their sizes.
answer.bn: df -h প্রতিটি mounted file system-এর size, used ও available space human-readable এককে (K, M, G) দেখায়; df -hT file-system type-ও দেখায়। du -sh <dir> একটি directory-র ব্যবহৃত জায়গা দেখায়; lsblk disk ও partition-এর size দেখায়।
